id: 04_Compressed Gas Cylinders Installation and Removal of a Regulator Equipment Safet
title: 压缩气瓶：减压器的安装与拆卸
source_doc: course/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/04_Compressed Gas Cylinders Installation and Removal of a Regulator Equipment Safet.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/04_Compressed Gas Cylinders Installation and Removal of a Regulator Equipment Safet/src.py

points.K1: 先了解气体的性质和危害
points.K4: 选对减压器，不用转接头
points.K8: 旋入时不站出口正前方
points.K9: 先手拧，再用扳手，不拧过头
points.K10: 可燃、氧化性气体用防爆工具
points.K11: 缓慢开瓶阀，出口背向人
points.K12: 再调到需要的输出压力
points.K16: 安全阀排气引到通风处
points.K17: 不用时别让减压器带压
points.K22: 查本校手册，有疑问就问

shots.scene: 欣欣站在两只固定好的气瓶旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside two gas cylinders strapped to a lab wall and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲气瓶减压器怎么装、怎么拆。
overlay: 气瓶减压器的安装与拆卸

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一个减压器，对着一只新气瓶比划
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a pressure regulator and looks uncertainly at a new gas cylinder against the wall.
shots.narration: 阿杰要换气瓶，减压器该怎么装？

shots.scene: 小研穿实验服戴手套走过来，接过减压器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and blue gloves walks over and takes the regulator from him.
shots.narration: 小研说：跟着我，一步一步来。

shots.section_title: 先了解气体的性质和危害
shots.scene: 安装前分段标题：一只气瓶和一个减压器图标
shots.prompt_en: A clean title card showing only a gas cylinder icon and a regulator icon with a small clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安装之前，先了解你用的气体。
overlay: 先了解气体的性质和危害

shots.section_title: 先了解气体的性质和危害
shots.scene: 小研戴手套翻阅空白安全技术说明书，旁边浮出四个菱形危险标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in blue gloves flips through a blank safety data sheet, while four dangerous goods diamond labels float beside it.
shots.narration: 它有什么性质，有什么危害。

shots.section_title: 先了解气体的性质和危害
shots.scene: 小研拿起电话，旁边是空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a phone next to a blank safety data sheet on the bench.
shots.narration: 查安全技术说明书，或问生产商。

shots.scene: 小研把黑色绑带扣到墙上的固定座，捆住两只气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student buckles a black nylon strap to a yellow wall bracket around two dark red gas cylinders.
shots.narration: 用链条或合适的绑带固定气瓶。

shots.scene: 气瓶示意图，绑带位置在中点以上、瓶肩以下，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A simple cylinder diagram with a strap band between the midpoint and the shoulder, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 位置在中点以上、瓶肩以下。

shots.scene: 小研双手旋下绿色瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student unscrews a green protective cap from the top of the gas cylinder with both hands.
shots.narration: 取下瓶帽，太紧可用瓶帽钩。

shots.scene: 用撬棍撬瓶帽的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pry bar forcing off a cylinder cap, crossed out with a big red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能用蛮力去撬。

shots.section_title: 选对减压器，不用转接头
shots.scene: 减压器表盘与调压手柄特写，表盘空白
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a general purpose regulator with two blank gauges and an adjusting knob. No people.
shots.narration: 接着，选对减压器。
overlay: 选对减压器，不用转接头

shots.section_title: 选对减压器，不用转接头
shots.scene: 瓶阀出口和减压器接口并排，各带一个空白编号牌
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder valve outlet thread and a brass regulator inlet thread side by side, each with a matching blank number tag and an equals sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶阀和减压器的接口编号要一致。

shots.section_title: 选对减压器，不用转接头
shots.scene: 转接头图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small adapter fitting between a regulator and a valve, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能用转接头连接。

shots.scene: 老周在气瓶旁端详手中的减压器，墙上贴着空白告示
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands beside chained cylinders and closely inspects a regulator in his hands; a blank notice hangs on the wall.
shots.narration: 每次使用前，先目视检查。

shots.scene: 裂纹、锈蚀、压瘪三个缺陷图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a cracked gauge, a rusty fitting, and a dented valve. No people.
shots.narration: 看有没有损坏、裂纹、腐蚀。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手把调压手柄旋到关闭
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand turns the adjusting knob of the regulator to the closed position. No people.
shots.narration: 接上气瓶前，确认调压阀关闭。

shots.scene: 往螺纹上缠白色胶带的小图被红色斜杠划掉
shots.prompt_en: A small inset picture of white sealing tape being wrapped on a threaded fitting, crossed out with a red slash. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶和管件接头，不缠生料带。

shots.section_title: 旋入时不站出口正前方
shots.scene: 小研双手把减压器接头对准瓶阀出口旋入
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in blue gloves lines up the regulator fitting with the cylinder valve outlet and threads it in by hand, standing to one side.
shots.narration: 旋入减压器时，人站到一边。
overlay: 旋入时不站出口正前方

shots.section_title: 旋入时不站出口正前方
shots.scene: 人站在出口正前方的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person standing directly in line with a regulator and valve outlet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要正对减压器和阀门出口。

shots.section_title: 旋入时不站出口正前方
shots.scene: 接头旋不进去，旁边问号图标
shots.prompt_en: A regulator fitting that will not thread onto a valve outlet, with a question mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 装不上，说明减压器选错了。

shots.section_title: 先手拧，再用扳手，不拧过头
shots.scene: 小研先用手拧紧，再用活动扳手卡住螺母
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tightens the connection nut by hand, then fits a smooth-jawed adjustable wrench onto it.
shots.narration: 先用手拧紧，再用平口扳手。
overlay: 先手拧，再用扳手，不拧过头

shots.section_title: 先手拧，再用扳手，不拧过头
shots.scene: 接头被拧变形的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a brass nut bent out of shape by a wrench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别拧过头，黄铜接头容易变形。

shots.section_title: 可燃、氧化性气体用防爆工具
shots.scene: 火焰和助燃图标旁放着一把防爆扳手
shots.prompt_en: A flammable gas icon and an oxidizer icon beside a non-sparking wrench with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃或氧化性气体，用防火花工具。
overlay: 可燃、氧化性气体用防爆工具

shots.section_title: 缓慢开瓶阀，出口背向人
shots.scene: 装好后分段标题：减压器图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A clean title card showing only a regulator icon attached to a cylinder with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 减压器装好了，开始加压。
overlay: 缓慢开瓶阀，出口背向人

shots.section_title: 缓慢开瓶阀，出口背向人
shots.scene: 小研缓慢转动瓶阀手轮，两块压力表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly turns the cylinder valve handwheel while the two regulator gauges respond.
shots.narration: 先开主阀，慢慢给减压器加压。

shots.section_title: 缓慢开瓶阀，出口背向人
shots.scene: 减压器出口朝向墙面，箭头背离人员
shots.prompt_en: A regulator outlet pointing toward a blank wall with an arrow pointing away from a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 开阀时，出口和减压器背向人。

shots.section_title: 再调到需要的输出压力
shots.scene: 小研旋调压手柄，压力表指针缓缓上升
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the regulator knob while the outlet gauge needle rises gently.
shots.narration: 再调输出调压阀，到所需压力。
overlay: 再调到需要的输出压力

shots.scene: 喷壶向接口喷检漏液，纸巾托在下方，黄圈标出接口
shots.prompt_en: A spray bottle mists leak detection liquid onto the regulator connection with a paper towel held below; a yellow circle highlights the joint. No people.
shots.narration: 检查连接处有没有泄漏。

shots.scene: 气泡图标和压力表图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: soap bubbles on a fitting and a pressure gauge with a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 按气体种类，用气泡法或保压法。

shots.scene: 小研关闭瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the cylinder valve.
shots.narration: 有泄漏，先关主阀止住漏气。

shots.scene: 小研用扳手重新紧固接头，黄圈再标出接口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student re-tightens the connection nut with a wrench; a yellow circle highlights the joint again.
shots.narration: 再用扳手紧固，重新检查。

shots.scene: 减压器旁浮现更换箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A regulator icon with a circular swap arrow next to a new regulator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 拧到位还漏，可能要换减压器。

shots.scene: 装好减压器的气瓶全景，管路接到仪器
shots.prompt_en: A secured cylinder with a regulator connected by tubing to a lab instrument, green check marks at each joint. No people.
shots.narration: 装好、无漏、接上设备。

shots.scene: 一只蓝色气瓶挂着空白三段式状态吊牌
shots.prompt_en: A blue gas cylinder with a blank three-part status tag hanging from its neck. No people.
shots.narration: 气体就可以使用了。

shots.section_title: 安全阀排气引到通风处
shots.scene: 减压器安全阀接一根软管通向通风橱
shots.prompt_en: A tube runs from the regulator relief valve into a lab fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃或有毒气体，安全阀引到通风橱。
overlay: 安全阀排气引到通风处

shots.section_title: 不用时别让减压器带压
shots.scene: 关着的气瓶和减压器，旁边一个时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed cylinder with its regulator gauges reading zero and a clock icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 不用时别让减压器一直带压。
overlay: 不用时别让减压器带压

shots.section_title: 不用时别让减压器带压
shots.scene: 减压器图标旁浮现盾牌和准星图标
shots.prompt_en: A regulator icon with a shield icon and a target icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 这样更耐用，读数也更准。

shots.scene: 小研一手扶瓶，一手关闭瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the cylinder with one hand and closes the cylinder valve with the other.
shots.narration: 用完了，先关气瓶主阀。

shots.scene: 压力表指针慢慢回零
shots.prompt_en: Both regulator gauge needles slowly fall back to zero. No people.
shots.narration: 让减压器里的气体放尽。

shots.scene: 小研关上减压器出口阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the small outlet valve on the regulator.
shots.narration: 有出口阀的，最后关上它。

shots.scene: 拆卸分段标题后，小研检查瓶阀，压力表归零
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks that the cylinder valve is closed while both gauges read zero, holding the cylinder with her other hand.
shots.narration: 拆之前，确认瓶阀关闭、系统泄压。

shots.scene: 小研一手扶减压器，一手用扳手松开螺母
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student supports the regulator with one hand and loosens the nut with a wrench.
shots.narration: 先用扳手松开，再用手旋下。

shots.scene: 小研把绿色瓶帽旋回气瓶顶部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student screws the green protective cap back onto the top of the cylinder.
shots.narration: 拆下后，马上装回瓶帽。

shots.scene: 瓶帽护住瓶阀的示意，旁边推车图标
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a cap shielding the valve with a shield icon, next to a cylinder cart icon. No people.
shots.narration: 储存和运输时，瓶帽保护瓶阀。

shots.section_title: 查本校手册，有疑问就问
shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一本空白的气瓶安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank gas cylinder safety handbook.
shots.narration: 更多内容查气瓶安全手册，不懂就问。
overlay: 查本校手册，有疑问就问

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现绑带、减压器、扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a strap, a regulator and a wrench.
shots.narration: 固定气瓶，选对减压器，手拧再扳。

shots.scene: 慢开阀、气泡、关阀归零三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a slowly turning handwheel, soap bubbles and gauges at zero. No people.
shots.narration: 慢开加压，检查泄漏，用完关阀。

shots.scene: 欣欣在固定好的气瓶旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a capped, strapped gas cylinder.
shots.narration: 装对减压器，安全用好气，下次见！
